articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Aave (AAVE) gains 5.9% as index moves higher
articles.snippet: Internet Computer (ICP), up 2% from Tuesday, joined Aave (AAVE) as a top performer.

articles.title: Aave could soar to $3,500 by 2030 on DeFi revival, says StanChart
articles.snippet: Geoff Kendrick said Aave has moved past April's cyberattack-related market disruption and is well positioned to benefit from growth in tokenized assets and DeFi.

articles.title: Aave positioned to capture tokenized asset growth in DeFi: Standard Chartered
articles.snippet: Standard Chartered said tokenized assets moving into DeFi could drive deposits into Aave and help the protocol rebuild its position as a dominant onchain lending platform.
